Sync error codes (bad_request … internal; 2 MiB / 50 MiB limits)
Права: user — документы своего аккаунта; guest — только документы шеринга, push только с правом edit
Server may delete updates seq <= baseSeq except those needed by version history
Client skips undecryptable/unappliable item, reports {docId, seq, deviceId, reason}, may resubscribe once with since: 0
Snapshots and compaction (R-05): >500 updates or >1 MiB, and on document close after >=30 local edits
Subscribe with since < latest snapshot seq always returns latest snapshot + later updates
nodes.rationale: Always (not only after compaction): fewer updates to apply, and a client that missed a corrupted update recovers from a later snapshot. Proposed by core stream, accepted 2026-10-26.

nodes.label: Mandatory seq ordering rule
nodes.rationale: seq assignment and broadcast serialized per doc; ack only after write; otherwise update could be lost on disconnect

Error ref = clientMsgId for push/snapshot errors, else docId

Ordering (mandatory for server): seq assignment and broadcast serialized per document; ack after write; gaps allowed
nodes.rationale: Client stores lastSeq = max(seq); out-of-order delivery could lose an update on disconnect.
